sections.preamble: You are a coding assistant running inside pi, a coding agent harness. Help users inspect files, run commands, and modify code.
sections.tools:
<tools>
- read: Read file contents
- write: Create or overwrite files
- edit: Make precise file edits with exact text replacement, including multiple disjoint edits in one call

Additional tools may be available.
</tools>
sections.rules:
<rules>
- Use read to examine files instead of cat or sed.
- Use write only for new files or complete rewrites.
- Use edit for targeted changes. Batch changes to one file in a single call.
- Each edits[].oldText must exactly and uniquely match the original file. Keep matches short and non-overlapping; merge nearby changes without including large unchanged regions.
- Be concise in your responses
- Show file paths clearly when working with files
</rules>

toolsAdded.name: read
toolsAdded.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

toolsAdded.name: write
toolsAdded.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

toolsAdded.name: edit
toolsAdded.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="800" height="600" viewBox="0 0 800 600" role="img" aria-labelledby="title desc">
  <title id="title">Anteater riding a unicycle while juggling bottles</title>
  <desc id="desc">A smiling brown anteater pedals a red unicycle and juggles three colorful bottles under a sunny sky.</desc>

  <defs>
    <!-- One bottle, centered on (0,0); color comes from `color` on the <use> -->
    <g id="bottle">
      <path d="M -5 -30 L -5 -17 C -5 -12 -11 -9 -11 -2 L -11 15 C -11 21 -7 24 0 24 C 7 24 11 21 11 15 L 11 -2 C 11 -9 5 -12 5 -17 L 5 -30 Z"
            fill="currentColor" stroke="#203018" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <rect x="-6" y="-36" width="12" height="7" rx="2" fill="#f4c542" stroke="#8a6414" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <rect x="-11" y="2" width="22" height="11" fill="#fff8e6" opacity="0.9"/>
      <rect x="-4" y="-22" width="3.5" height="38" rx="1.75" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.45"/>
    </g>

    <g id="spoke">
      <line x1="400" y1="430" x2="400" y2="382" stroke="#8d99ae" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="400" y1="430" x2="448" y2="430" stroke="#8d99ae" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="400" y1="430" x2="400" y2="478" stroke="#8d99ae" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="400" y1="430" x2="352" y2="430" stroke="#8d99ae" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="400" y1="430" x2="434" y2="396" stroke="#c3ccd9" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="400" y1="430" x2="434" y2="464" stroke="#c3ccd9" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="400" y1="430" x2="366" y2="464" stroke="#c3ccd9" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="400" y1="430" x2="366" y2="396" stroke="#c3ccd9" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>

    <g id="grass">
      <path d="M0 0 Q3 -14 7 -18 Q8 -8 10 0 Q14 -12 20 -15 Q19 -6 22 0" fill="none" stroke="#4e9b47" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>
  </defs>

  <!-- Sky -->
  <rect width="800" height="600" fill="#aee3f5"/>
  <rect y="470" width="800" height="130" fill="#8ed081"/>

  <!-- Sun -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="92" cy="88" r="38" fill="#ffd93d" stroke="#f4a923" stroke-width="4"/>
    <g stroke="#f4a923" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round">
      <line x1="92" y1="28" x2="92" y2="12"/><line x1="92" y1="148" x2="92" y2="164"/>
      <line x1="32" y1="88" x2="16" y2="88"/><line x1="152" y1="88" x2="168" y2="88"/>
      <line x1="50" y1="46" x2="39" y2="35"/><line x1="134" y1="46" x2="145" y2="35"/>
      <line x1="50" y1="130" x2="39" y2="141"/><line x1="134" y1="130" x2="145" y2="141"/>
    </g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-4 92 88; 4 92 88; -4 92 88" dur="9s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Drifting clouds -->
  <g fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.95">
    <g>
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="46" ry="22"/><ellipse cx="-30" cy="8" rx="30" ry="16"/><ellipse cx="32" cy="8" rx="34" ry="17"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="-120 82; 920 82" dur="38s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
    <g opacity="0.85">
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="36" ry="17"/><ellipse cx="-24" cy="6" rx="24" ry="12"/><ellipse cx="26" cy="6" rx="26" ry="13"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="920 150; -120 150" dur="52s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Road -->
  <rect y="486" width="800" height="58" fill="#f7e8a0"/>
  <g stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.9">
    <g>
      <line x1="20" y1="516" x2="90" y2="516"/><line x1="140" y1="516" x2="210" y2="516"/>
      <line x1="260" y1="516" x2="330" y2="516"/><line x1="380" y1="516" x2="450" y2="516"/>
      <line x1="500" y1="516" x2="570" y2="516"/><line x1="620" y1="516" x2="690" y2="516"/>
      <line x1="740" y1="516" x2="810" y2="516"/><line x1="860" y1="516" x2="930" y2="516"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0; -120 0" dur="0.9s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
  </g>
  <g>
    <use href="#grass" x="60" y="492"/><use href="#grass" x="680" y="486"/><use href="#grass" x="740" y="556"/>
    <use href="#grass" x="110" y="562"/><use href="#grass" x="560" y="566"/>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="30 0; -30 0; 30 0" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Soft shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="400" cy="492" rx="105" ry="13" fill="#3d6b35" opacity="0.28">
    <animate attributeName="rx" values="105; 96; 105" dur="1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </ellipse>

  <!-- Unicycle wheel -->
  <g>
    <use href="#spoke"/>
    <circle cx="400" cy="430" r="56" fill="none" stroke="#343a40" stroke-width="11"/>
    <circle cx="400" cy="430" r="49" fill="none" stroke="#e63946" stroke-width="4"/>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 400 430" to="360 400 430" dur="1.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Cranks & pedals (same speed as the wheel) -->
  <g>
    <line x1="400" y1="430" x2="428" y2="430" stroke="#495057" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="400" y1="430" x2="372" y2="430" stroke="#495057" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <rect x="416" y="424" width="26" height="9" rx="4" fill="#212529"/>
    <rect x="358" y="424" width="26" height="9" rx="4" fill="#212529"/>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 400 430" to="360 400 430" dur="1.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </g>
  <circle cx="400" cy="430" r="10" fill="#495057" stroke="#212529" stroke-width="3"/>
  <!-- Frame & seat -->
  <path d="M 386 356 L 400 430 L 414 356" fill="none" stroke="#e63946" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="400" y1="356" x2="400" y2="334" stroke="#495057" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M 362 334 Q 400 318 438 334 Q 400 344 362 334 Z" fill="#6d3b1f" stroke="#472610" stroke-width="3"/>

  <!-- Everything that bobs while pedalling -->
  <g>
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 0; 0 -6; 0 0" dur="0.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>

    <!-- Bushy tail, swaying -->
    <g>
      <path d="M 316 282 C 240 282 190 240 178 168 C 176 152 190 144 202 154 C 244 190 282 218 326 242 Z"
            fill="#7a4a21" stroke="#54300f" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <path d="M 292 254 C 244 238 214 208 198 176" fill="none" stroke="#96683a" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-3 316 282; 4 316 282; -3 316 282" dur="1.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

tools.name: write
tools.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.
